correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the precise rank-selected poset and its C_p-equivariant equivalence with the open-neighborhood complex. It gives an explicit equivariant barycentric deformation retraction of a sphere minus the crown subcomplex onto the rank-selected complex; the free translation sphere quotient is the lens space with weights 1 through (p-1)/2. The quotient crown graph has two vertices, p-1 edges, and edge-loop voltage a-b. Shellability yields (p-5)-connectivity of the cover and its exact top sphere count. Cartan-Leray plus dimension/Euler prove all integral homology, while the classifying-space spectral sequence proves power nonvanishing and mod-p cup-length. Standalone exact finite-field boundary checks corroborate the p=7 case but are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The statement is a uniform geometric classification for the canonical free prime-cyclic symmetry of a classical neighborhood complex. Identifying an actual embedded two-vertex voltage graph inside a weighted lens space is structural and preserves information beyond homology ranks. It also establishes exact p-primary torsion across unboundedly many degrees and unbounded mod-p cup-length, sharpening rational covering representations and leaving concrete geometric embedding questions for further work.
